kept.what: The monkey's arms, ears and hands blend into one shapeless mass around the head, with dark balls for hands that look like extra ears
kept.where: the monkey's head and raised arms
kept.expected: Ears, arms and hands should be separate and recognisable, with the arms clearly reaching up the trunk

kept.what: The legs are thin sticks ending in dark ovals and blend into a stray line on the trunk, so you can't count the legs and tail
kept.where: the monkey's lower body and the trunk below it
kept.expected: Two clear legs gripping the trunk and one clearly visible tail

kept.what: Stray dark lines and blobs run down the trunk below the monkey and look like broken pieces
kept.where: the middle of the trunk under the monkey
kept.expected: The trunk should be clean, and only the monkey's own limbs should show on it

kept.what: A huge pale sun is cut off at the edge and fills much of the upper right, so it competes with the tree
kept.expected: A smaller sun that sits fully in the sky and stays in the background

kept.what: The monkey's hands and feet don't clearly hold the trunk; the feet sit as flat ovals on its surface
kept.expected: Hands and feet should visibly wrap around and grip the trunk
